item.title: Notice from the Bates County Pantry Thrift Store
item.description: The Pantry Thrift Store will be closing early, at 3 p.m. on Christmas eve. We will remain closed for a holiday break until Wednesday, January 7th. Please hold all donations until then to allow our staff and volunteers to enjoy time off.

item.title: Coats for Kids drawing winner
item.description: Carol Ann Winburn and the staff at DSWA CPAs in Butler are pleased to report that the Coats for Kids project is responsible for over 260 Bates County youngsters receiving brand-new coats this year. All contributors were entered in a drawing Dec. 19, for a counter-top ice maker, and the winner is Patty Hoskins of Butler.Every year school nurses and teachers from ten school systems across the county nominate students and pre-schoolers who might not have a warm coat that fits if not for Coats for K

item.title: Elks make large donation aimed at helping local families
item.description: The Bates County Elks do it again filling 8 carts full of supplies to give out to 10 families in need this holiday season. Thank you for your ongoing dedication to the community!

item.title: History comes alive on the Butler square
item.description: THE GREEN SPACE on the southeast corner of the Butler square has taken on a whole new look as murals depicting some of our rich local history are now on display.The restored murals are the result of many hours of hard work put forth by the Butler Historical Preservation Commission and Electric City downtown- stop by and take a look.A special thank-you goes to Creative Home Specialist for erecting the murals and to Doctor Curtis Long for his generous donation to offset expenses.

item.title: Tactical Response Team assists with arrest in Harrisonville
item.description: On December 21st at approximately 3:30 pm, a search warrant was served in the 600 block of North Independence Street. Due to the nature of the search warrant, the Cass County Sheriff's Office Tactical Response Team was deployed to serve the warrant. There were no injuries to anyone involved. One person was taken into custody and is being held at the Cass County Jail. Thank you to the Cass County Sheriffs Office and Harrisonville Fire Department for your assistance.Courtesy Harrisonville Police D

item.title: Obituary - Donald Stark
item.description: Donald Ray Stark was born on August 19, 1946, in Bartlesville, Oklahoma, the son of Harvey and Derilla Stark. He departed this life on December 20, 2025, at the age of 79.Donald spent his life as a hardworking and devoted man who took pride in providing for his family. He enjoyed fishing, antique cars and spending time with family especially his grandsons. He was a longtime member of Harrisonville Church of the Nazarene, where his faith guided his life. item.title: Missing Juvenile – Public Assistance Requested
item.description: Linn County, KS — The Linn County Sheriff’s Office is requesting the public’s assistance in locating a missing juvenile.Airen Andula, a 13-year-old male, was last seen at approximately 8:00 a.m. in the Holiday Lakes community. Airen is described as 5 feet 6 inches tall, weighing approximately 130 pounds. At the time he was last seen, he was wearing a red hoodie and black jeans and was riding a red mountain bike.It is believed that Airen may have traveled toward or into the Pleasanton area.Anyone
